grammar.title: Phrasal Verbs Digitais — Log in, Sign up, Scroll through
rules: "Log in / log out" significa entrar/sair de uma conta: I need to log in to my account.
"Sign up (for)" significa se cadastrar: She signed up for a new app.
"Scroll through" significa rolar (uma tela, feed): I was scrolling through my feed all night.
